sources.name: defillama_hacks
sources.description: DefiLlama hacks & exploits database — public JSON endpoint (api.llama.fi/hacks), no auth required.

sources.name: rekt_news_leaderboard
sources.description: REKT News leaderboard of major crypto exploits — public JSON API (api.rekt.news/leaderboard).

sources.name: slowmist_hacked
sources.description: SlowMist Hacked database (hacked.slowmist.io) — HTML page; no verified public JSON endpoint yet. Wired but disabled until a parser exists.

sources.name: certik_security_alerts
sources.description: CertiK security alerts (alert.certik.org) — Cloudflare-protected page; no verified unauthenticated JSON endpoint yet. Wired but disabled until a parser exists.

sources.name: metamask_eth_phishing_detect
sources.description: MetaMask eth-phishing-detect — canonical phishing-domain blacklist (raw GitHub JSON src/config.json: blacklist/tolerance/fuzz/lists). MIT. Wired but disabled until a domain-list parser exists (normalizer expects dict records; this feed is a list of domain strings).

sources.name: defihacklabs_incidents
sources.description: DeFiHackLabs — 600+ exploit incident records (project, amount lost, date, chain, technique) in a single markdown table (raw GitHub docs/Incidents_All.md). Educational repo; license flagged [REVIEW]. Wired but disabled until a markdown-table parser exists.

sources.name: ethereum_labels_0x406
sources.description: 0x406/ethereum-labels — labeled EVM addresses by category (mixers, exchanges, MEV bots, phishing, hackers) as per-category CSV files. MIT (flagged [REVIEW]). Wired but disabled until a CSV parser exists.

sources.name: consensys_best_practices
sources.description: ConsenSys Diligence Smart Contract Security Best Practices (canonical Solidity security guidance: known attacks, development recommendations, secure design). Raw markdown at master; docs/ tree (docs/attacks/*.md, docs/development-recommendations/*.md) expands per-topic. License [REVIEW]: repo has no LICENSE file (historically CC BY-SA 4.0). Wired disabled until a markdown-doc ingest path exists.

sources.name: not_so_smart_contracts
sources.description: Trail of Bits NotSoSmartContracts — real vulnerable contract examples with explanations (reentrancy, honeypots, integer overflow, race conditions, unchecked calls). Apache-2.0; repo archived (read-only → URL stable). Raw markdown README + per-vuln subdir READMEs (honeypots/, reentrancy/). Wired disabled until a markdown-doc ingest path exists.

sources.name: smart_contract_vulnerabilities
sources.description: KadenZipfel Smart Contract Vulnerabilities (formerly smart-contract-attack-vectors) — ~30 attack vectors with PoC code + references (reentrancy, tx.origin auth, signature malleability, flash-loan oracle manipulation, DoS). MIT, active. Raw markdown README index + references/*.md per vector. Wired disabled until a markdown-doc ingest path exists.

sources.name: solidity_security_considerations
sources.description: Official Solidity documentation 'Security Considerations' chapter (pitfalls, recommendations, smart-contract security guidance from docs.soliditylang.org source). GPL-3.0 (repo license). Raw RST at develop. [REVIEW]: ethereum/solidity GitHub redirect observed (argotorg mirror) but raw URL serves canonical content and git refs resolve. Wired disabled until a markdown/RST ingest path exists.

sources.name: openzeppelin_upgradeable_docs
sources.description: OpenZeppelin Contracts docs — 'Upgradeable' chapter (proxy patterns, upgrade risks, storage collisions, unsafe upgrade flows) feeding proxy-risk rug detection. MIT, active. Raw AsciiDoc at master. Wired disabled until a markdown/AsciiDoc ingest path exists.
